name: resume-tailoring

summary.en: Builds a tailored résumé for a specific job from the user’s own résumé library, researching the role and asking questions to surface relevant experience.
summary.zh: 基于用户已有的简历素材为特定职位定制简历，会调研岗位并通过提问挖掘相关经历。

upstreamDescription: Use when creating tailored resumes for job applications - researches company/role, creates optimized templates, conducts branching experience discovery to surface undocumented skills, and generates professional multi-format resumes from user's resume library while maintaining factual integrity
